title: Web Summit schedule, filtered to press conferences, page 3 (Web Summit)
what_it_says: Page 3 of Web Summit's schedule filtered to the format 'Press conference', read at 02:34 UTC on 11 November 2026: session titles, start and end times, stage and speakers. The four pages list 23 sessions; the listing carries no notice about the Day 2 call-off. Read again at 12:33 UTC on 11 November (after Web Summit announced it is back on Thursday with sessions rescheduled from Wednesday): the same 23 sessions, none moved, added or removed; Wednesday's nine are still listed. Read again at 14:33 UTC on 11 November: still the same 23 sessions, none moved, added or removed. Read again at 16:33 UTC on 11 November: still the same 23 sessions, none moved, added or removed. Read again at 18:33 UTC on 11 November: 'Campus Tejo' (Wednesday 14:30) is no longer listed; 'Open or Closed AI models' appears twice with the same session id, on page 2 at Wednesday 12:30 and on page 3 at Thursday 10:00 (the pages disagree). 23 entries, 22 distinct sessions. Read again at 20:33 UTC on 11 November: the listing now has three pages (a fourth no longer exists), 21 entries for 19 distinct sessions (some entries repeat across pages): Tuesday 10, Wednesday 4 (all afternoon), Thursday 7 entries. Gone from Wednesday: Discord (10:30), Web Summit's CEO (11:00, now listed Thursday 11:00), Qualcomm (11:30), Open or Closed AI models (12:30, listed Thursday 10:00). No longer listed on any day: Discord, Qualcomm, Campus Tejo, Road 2 Web Summit 2026 Winner. Web Summit's post of 18:10 UTC on 11 November says the new lineup will be reflected in the schedule by Thursday morning (see S41), so this listing is mid-update.
